start: Today page, a gym with members, plans, receipts and visits

user_sees: Tiles 'Today's collection' (with 'This month <amount>'), 'Active members' ('With a running plan'), 'Ending today' ('Last day of their plan'), 'Ending in 1-3 days' ('Renew them now'), 'Ending in 4-7 days' ('Remind them this week'), 'Ending in 8-15 days' ('Coming up'), 'Expired', 'Fees due', 'Birthdays today' ('Send a wish'), 'Came in today' ('Open the register')
must_not: A tile showing NaN or blank
Archived members counted
A voided receipt counted in today's collection

user_sees: The Members list with the chip 'Ending in 1-3 days' and a count
must_not: A count different from the tile's number
A member whose plan ends today or in 4 days in this list

user_sees: Today's money page; its total equals the tile
must_not: A total that differs from the tile
Yesterday's receipts in today's list

start: Today page (the other kinds of tile, and a typed address)

user_sees: The Members list with the chip 'Birthdays today'; a member born on 29 February is in it on 28 February in a year with no 29th
must_not: A member with no birthday on file listed
A birthday skipped in a non-leap year

user_sees: The attendance register
must_not: A number on the tile that differs from the register's count for today

user_sees: The fees-due list; the tile's line says '1 member' or '<n> members'
must_not: '1 members'
A fully paid member listed

user_sees: The Members list with the chip 'Expired'
must_not: A different list than the tile opens

start: A brand-new gym with no member, plan sold, receipt, visit or enquiry; then a wrong address

user_sees: No tiles at all (every one would say 0); the set-up steps instead
must_not: A wall of zero tiles
An error

user_sees: The Members list without a tile chip (exact result not read)
must_not: A blank page
A chip with a raw key as its name

start: Today page with one member in 'Ending today' and one receipt taken today

steps.action: Renew the member who is in 'Ending today', come back to Today
user_sees: 'Ending today' is one lower; 'Active members' is unchanged
must_not: The old number until the page is reloaded
The member counted in two ending tiles

steps.action: Void today's receipt, come back to Today
user_sees: 'Today's collection' is lower by that amount; 'Fees due' is higher
must_not: The voided money still counted
'This month' unchanged

steps.action: Archive a member with a running plan
user_sees: 'Active members' is one lower
must_not: An archived member still counted

start: Today page as the owner of a gym with two branches and a front-desk login

user_sees: Numbers of branch A only
must_not: Members or money of branch B counted
Another gym's numbers

steps.action: Sign in as front desk and open Today
user_sees: The same tiles without 'Today's collection' and 'Fees due'
must_not: Any money total shown to the front desk

start: Today page, front-desk login, a gym with members

user_sees: Tiles 'Active members', 'Ending today', 'Ending in 1-3 days', 'Ending in 4-7 days', 'Ending in 8-15 days', 'Expired', 'Birthdays today', 'Came in today'
No 'Today's collection' and no 'Fees due' tile
must_not: A money total anywhere on the tiles
An empty gap where the money tiles would be

user_sees: The Members list with the chip 'Ending today' and the same count as the tile
must_not: A count different from the tile
A member marked expired on the last paid day

user_sees: The Members list with the chip 'Birthdays today'
must_not: Members of another branch listed

user_sees: The attendance register
must_not: A page the front desk may not open

start: Front-desk login types the address of a money tile's page

user_sees: A refusal or a page without totals (exact result not read)
must_not: Today's collection or any money total shown to the front desk
A blank page with no words

start: Today page, front-desk login, a member who has not come in today

steps.action: Check the member in, come back to Today
user_sees: 'Came in today' is one higher
must_not: The old number until a reload
The member counted twice after a second check-in the same day

steps.action: Undo the check-in (if the register allows), come back to Today
user_sees: 'Came in today' is back to the number before
must_not: A visit that is gone from the register still counted

start: Today page, front desk added to one branch of a two-branch gym

user_sees: Numbers of the desk's own branch only, no money tiles
must_not: Money totals
Members of the other branch counted
Birthdays of members of another branch
